text.text_excerpt: This place is pretty awesome. I just happened to walk by. They have a lot of healthy options to eat along with the usual sandwiches you'd expect. I got the butternut squash with lentils, olive tapenade and labneh which was awesome. It could have had more flavor but I didn't mind. They have the same gourmet chocolates I love at Gracious and you can expect to find the same pastries etc. There's a bar attached, which is nice. I love the spacious atmosphere and the large tables, but I wish there were more outlets. They have free WiFi but it makes it hard to work without outlets.

I hope this place keeps going - it's rarely busy but you get people stopping in throughout the day. You'll find some of the typical [AMAZING] Gracious Bakery pastries plus a few of the standards but there's also a good chef here coming up with fantastic sandwiches. Great ingredients plus great bread - that's pretty tough to beat. Everything I've had is tasty, though admittedly the ordering line can move slow and the wait for your food is often a bit more than you would expect for a largely empty restaurant. In typical Gracious Bakery fashion the decor is not very exciting but I'll take great food over atmosphere in most cases. This place comes through, I just hope they have enough busines...

Oh my gosh it's such a cute place! And the staff are incredibly friendly! I got an everything bagel with lemon caper cream cheese. I've never heard of lemon caper cream cheese and it's to die for. They really load on that cream cheese too! It hit the spot for my light lunch today. I ended up taking my bagel to go so I could go sit outside on my balcony, but it looks like it'd be a really nice place to work - and they have WiFi! It's really close to my office so I walked and it was great, but it's also right on the streetcar line which is convenient!
